title: SSMCP D4 input lease fix — independent fixed-source review

verdict.scope: F2→D4 ancestry and the exact storage.rs/test/doc delta only

ancestry.role: One new Unix test, +25/-0 in storage.rs

identity.corrected_fix_sha_note: The supplied fix identifier omitted 089; GitHub ancestry gives 10fdc1c10888c59799bb98908911033bacc3f046. The supplied identifier returned 404; no alternative commit was assumed.

findings.reason: Unlock is attached to InputLease destruction, before automatic File close. No unlock was added to off, revoke, ticket cancellation, or HostControl::run. Existing release-guard retention and cancellation ordering code remain byte-identical.

findings.evidence: #[cfg(unix)] on Drop and new test; storage.rs:59-62; Rust File::unlock docs
findings.reason: On the inspected Rust standard library contract, File::unlock maps to Unix flock(LOCK_UN), matching the existing platform::lock_file flock acquisition. Interrupted errors retry; success ends the loop. Other errors break and allow ordinary field destruction. No Windows Drop behavior was added. API stable since 1.89; crate requires 1.100.

The new test covers successful unlock and retained-descriptor behavior; it does not inject Interrupted or other unlock errors. Non-Interrupted errors are not reported by Drop and fall back to File destruction. This is an explicit coverage boundary, not evidence of a new failure.

try_clone retains the same open file description without launching a child. Assertions require exclusion while old lease lives; immediate acquisition after old lease drop despite the retained File; continued exclusion after closing that old File while the new lease lives; acquisition after new lease drop. No sleep, retry-based success, ignored annotation, reduced assertion or environment early-return was added.

The original off_drops_running_input_before_its_guard_is_released test and its final immediate try_input assertion remain unchanged. Removing the exact 13-line Drop and 25-line new test from D4 storage.rs reconstructs F2 storage.rs exactly.

findings.evidence: events.rs and source_tests.rs F2/D4 blobs identical; X→D4 only release-notes file
findings.reason: The image fix already present in F2 is carried into D4 without an additional change in this chain. This review does not independently re-validate image runtime behavior.

test_count_accounting.interpretation: Exactly one added source test. With the reported full-library selection, the +2 passed delta consists of one new test plus the formerly failing test becoming successful; it is not two newly added tests. This review does not independently assert per-test D4 execution because individual_output_complete is false and raw D4 runtime collection was intentionally not expanded.
test_count_accounting.transfer_boundary: D4-only owner-reported run; not V25, V/C or other source acceptance.

execution_boundary.normal_merge_owner: Existing native source author; no second implementation or merge performed by this reviewer.

references.claim: Custom Drop runs before field destruction
